entities.name: Borico Gavish
entities.description: The adolescent son of the castle's lord, who dreams of being a knight and defends the castle against imagined attackers.

entities.name: Gwaro
entities.description: A stooped, short-bearded troubadour favoured by Borico's father, who tells Borico the legend of the armor in the crypt.

entities.name: Kray
entities.description: The castle's master-at-arms, who comes to fetch Borico for his sword lesson.

entities.name: Armor in the Crypt
entities.description: An empty suit of armor standing guard in an alcove of the castle crypt; in Gwaro's legend it is the knight-brother who killed the necromancer.

entities.name: Leore the Dragonslayer
entities.description: A figure whose armor, in Borico's brother's version of the tale, could walk through dragon fire.

entities.name: The Necromancer
entities.description: A powerful necromancer in Gwaro's legend who raised the dead to march on the living and was beheaded by the brother.

entities.name: The Brother
entities.description: In Gwaro's legend, the lord's son who froze with fear, was killed by his undead sister, and whose spirit remained in his armor.

entities.name: The Sister
entities.description: In Gwaro's legend, the lord's daughter who entered the necromancer's monastery and returned as an undead horror.

entities.name: Age of Strife
entities.description: The era when warrior kings and queens forged their kingdom and the land was beset by evil.

events.summary: Borico seeks the cool of the castle crypt and plays at being a paladin with his wooden sword.
events.quote: He was a lone paladin, banishing darkness before him, and every corner of the crypt was made safe by the boy's heroic feats.

events.summary: Borico reaches the alcove with the empty suit of armor and is struck with awe.
events.quote: Standing there in front of it, Borico was struck with awe.

events.summary: Gwaro appears from the shadows and tells Borico that the common story of Leore the Dragonslayer is not the true story of the armor.
events.quote: "That is definitely a story, but begging your brother's pardon, not the story."

events.summary: Flashback in Gwaro's tale: the lord and lady dismiss a scout's warning of a vast undead army and ride out to battle.
events.quote: But the lord and lady of the castle dismissed the scout's warning.

events.summary: Flashback: the scout returns to announce the knights are all dead and the necromancer's army will arrive within hours.
events.quote: 'They are all dead.' The scout caught her breath.

events.summary: Flashback: the siblings, now lords of the castle, don their armor and ride out to avenge their parents.
events.quote: Sister and brother, the new lords of the castle, climbed into their suits of armor, and mounted their horses.

events.summary: Flashback: at the necromancer's monastery lair the severed heads on the door hiss and the brother freezes in fear while the sister goes in alone.
events.quote: Their pact drove her forward, while the brother remained at the entry.

events.summary: Flashback: the sister returns undead, a blade through her belly, pulls it free and strikes down her brother.
events.quote: The brother was not quite as fortunate as you, for the point of the blade bit into his throat just beneath his helm.

events.summary: Flashback: the brother awakens as a spirit in his armor, his body left behind.
events.quote: He was in the suit, but somehow his body was not.

events.summary: Flashback: the brother, no longer afraid, cuts through the undead and beheads the necromancer, fulfilling the pact, then rests in the crypt.
events.quote: The necromancer's magic held no sway over the brother's spirit, and in a single stroke, the brother struck the necromancer's head from his shoulders.

events.summary: Kray arrives and calls Borico away to his sword lesson, leaving Gwaro in the crypt.

relations.note: Gwaro is a favourite troubadour of Borico's father.
relations.quote: This was Gwaro, a favorite troubadour of his father's.

relations.note: Kray is the master-at-arms who instructs Borico.
relations.quote: Borico recognized it immediately as belonging to Kray, the master-at-arms.
The necromancer's magic held no sway over the brother's spirit, and in a single stroke, the brother struck the necromancer's head from his shoulders.

relations.note: The undead sister strikes her brother in the throat.
relations.quote: The brother was not quite as fortunate as you, for the point of the blade bit into his throat just beneath his helm.

relations.note: Siblings who made a pact to avenge their parents.
relations.quote: Years before, the siblings made a pact to seek vengeance for their father and mother should they fall in battle.
